scope: All P4 animated sources directly decoded at original dimensions. Original variable delays are separately compared with native constant frame rates; inherited timing mismatches are not certified as matching. Both five-cell hatch-mask copies use actual mask positioning/swing methods with deterministic scene updates. Unbracketed long PNG donor strips remain one frame in the current generic loader; no active directory consumer found. Their cells/pixels are preserved, not falsely certified as current animated battlers or assigned an invented playback duration. No full hatch dialogue/gameplay.

compatibility_issues.issue: Source frame delays [50, 100, 50, 2500] ms differ from native Bitmap constant 20.0 fps. Existing file is retained byte-for-byte; two observed native cycles do not prove source timing is honored.

pixel_comparison: Exact alpha and exact RGB wherever source alpha is nonzero; hidden RGB at alpha zero is not rendered.
